decisions.reason: The LHD loader was launched only a year ago and has long sales cycles in capital-intensive mining equipment, so there is no evidence yet of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search, and dropping it would forfeit sunk development investment.

The underground dump truck complements the loader in the same mining customer segment and is still within its early market-building phase, so management would carry it on available slack rather than drop it before results can be judged.
